fit: Histogram gradient boosting, 40 iterations, max 7 leaves, min 20 samples/leaf, L2=1. Synthetic truth labels in TRAIN only; public input features. No test fitting.
selection: Each component is eligible only if DEV pooled Brier beats never-infer baseline; combined estimator must not increase total count MAE on DEV relative to guarded filter. Otherwise retain guarded filter. Freeze choice before TEST.
future_scope: Public structural simulator laws supplied to all model-based projections. Current true state only to diagnostic oracle. Fresh independent planning futures. Same action catalogue and budgets.
chronology: 60 monthly synthetic episodes per structure, each with 7-day warmup. Independent episode innovations; same structure across months; no continuity claim across monthly boundaries. Ten non-overlapping semesters, train months 1-5, forecast month 6 without new observations; carry weights across rounds. Train and test structures disjoint.
jepe_comparison: Same model initialization, batches, budgets; optional target EMA encoder and latent prediction. Fixed physical loss, normalized latent loss and variance guard. No TEST-based hyperparameter selection.
status: PROTOTYPE_UNVALIDATED; synthetic only; positive latent gap reduction alone is not a decision gate.
